newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN cuts Sullivan Dental.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN cuts Sullivan Dental.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it cut its rating for Sullivan Dental Products Inc to market performer from outperform for the intermediate term.
-- EVEREN said the move is a response to significant gains in the price of the company's stock in the last six months, which stemmed from improving earnings growth and stability.
-- Sullivan is currently slightly ahead of EVEREN's six-month target of $15, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said it is also raising its earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 to $1.03 a share from $1.01 and the estimate for fiscal 1998 to $1.15 from $1.13.
-- Sullivan markets dental products and equipment.
-- Its shares were off 3/8 Wednesday at 15-1/4.
